Bring the resume and self attested copies of all the certificates with originals.
Candidates reporting late, beyond 03:00 p.m., shall not be considered.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for IIT Bombay Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 19 November 2026, and candidates report at 3:00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IIT Bombay Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Part-Time Paediatrician.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for IIT Bombay Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 19 November 2026 at 3:00 PM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Seminar Room, IIT Bombay Hospital.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 55 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 64,222 p.m. (base Rs. 39,400 + Rs. 24,822 inflation compensation), at par with level EO3 on pro rata basis.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: M.D. (Paediatrics) with 3 years of clinical experience, preferably in a large Institution.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Working hours: 20 hours per week (to visit 5 days a week for 4 hrs.).

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates reporting late for the selection process, beyond 03:00 p.m., shall not be considered.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in Selection Process.
